image.name: retroarch
image.description: [RetroArch](https://retroarch.com/) is a frontend for emulators, game engines and media players. It enables you to run classic games on a wide range of computers and consoles through its slick graphical interface.

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: RetroArch desktop gui HTTP must be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This is needed for retroarch to function.

image.title: Retroarch
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

**Note: In pure CPU mode RetroArch will use LLVMPipe for menu rendering, when in game this is less of an issue. You can configure things like the menu refresh rate in your RetroArch settings or mount in an Nvidia GPU. When running with an Nvidia GPU it will be necesarry to right click the desktop and re-launch RetroArch on your first launch only.**

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  retroarch:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/retroarch:latest
    container_name: retroarch
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=retroarch \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/retroarch:latest
